mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, description, type, priority, status, handler_id, user_phone, user_nickname, result, tags, summary, session_id, matching_skill, dispatch_confidence, biz_tag, emotion_level, sla_deadline, response_deadline, responded_at, sla_paused, effective_response_seconds, effective_resolution_seconds, first_responder_id, resolver_id, exclude_from_sla, rating, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_orders (user_id, title, description, type, priority, status, handler_id, user_phone, user_nickname, result, tags, summary, session_id, matching_skill, dispatch_confidence, biz_tag, emotion_level, sla_deadline, response_deadline, responded_at, sla_paused, effective_response_seconds, effective_resolution_seconds, first_responder_id, resolver_id, exclude_from_sla, rating, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{type}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{handlerId}, #{userPhone}, #{userNickname}, #{result}, #{tags}, #{summary}, #{sessionId}, #{matchingSkill}, #{dispatchConfidence}, #{bizTag}, #{emotionLevel}, #{slaDeadline}, #{responseDeadline}, #{respondedAt}, 0, null, null, null, null, 0, #{rating}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM work_orders WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM work_orders ORDER BY FIELD(priority, 'high', 'medium', 'low'), create_time DESC
SELECT FROM work_orders ORDER BY FIELD(priority, 'high', 'medium', 'low'), create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders
SELECT FROM work_orders WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN (#{pendingStatus}, #{processingStatus})
SELECT FROM work_orders WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM work_orders WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT FROM work_orders WHERE handler_id = #{handlerId}
SELECT FROM work_orders WHERE handler_id IS NULL AND status = #{pendingStatus} ORDER BY FIELD(priority, 'high', 'medium', 'low'), create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders WHERE handler_id = #{handlerId} AND status IN (#{pendingStatus}, #{processingStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE work_orders SET handler_id = #{handlerId}, status = #{processingStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND handler_id IS NULL AND status = #{pendingStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT status AS statusKey, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM work_orders WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY status
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM work_orders WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders WHERE first_responder_id = #{agentId} AND exclude_from_sla = 0 AND responded_at IS NOT NULL AND response_deadline IS NOT NULL AND responded_at <= response_deadline AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders WHERE resolver_id = #{agentId} AND exclude_from_sla = 0 AND status = 'completed' AND sla_deadline IS NOT NULL AND update_time <= sla_deadline AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders WHERE resolver_id = #{agentId} AND exclude_from_sla = 0 AND status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND sla_deadline IS NOT NULL AND update_time > sla_deadline AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT AVG(effective_response_seconds) FROM work_orders WHERE exclude_from_sla = 0 AND effective_response_seconds IS NOT NULL AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT AVG(effective_resolution_seconds) FROM work_orders WHERE exclude_from_sla = 0 AND effective_resolution_seconds IS NOT NULL AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders WHERE ((first_responder_id = #{agentId}) OR (resolver_id = #{agentId})) AND exclude_from_sla = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS statDate, SUM(CASE WHEN (first_responder_id = #{agentId} AND responded_at IS NOT NULL AND responded_at <= response_deadline) OR (resolver_id = #{agentId} AND status = 'completed' AND update_time <= sla_deadline) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slaCompliant, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM work_orders WHERE exclude_from_sla = 0 AND (first_responder_id = #{agentId} OR resolver_id = #{agentId}) AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalWorkOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN responded_at IS NOT NULL AND responded_at <= response_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responseCompliant, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND update_time <= sla_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolutionCompliant, SUM(CASE WHEN (responded_at IS NULL OR responded_at > response_deadline) AND response_deadline IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responseBreached, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('completed','cancelled') AND update_time > sla_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolutionBreached FROM work_orders WHERE exclude_from_sla = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(first_responder_id, resolver_id) AS agentId, COUNT(*) AS totalWorkOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN (first_responder_id IS NOT NULL AND responded_at IS NOT NULL AND responded_at <= response_deadline) OR (resolver_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'completed' AND update_time <= sla_deadline) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slaCompliant FROM work_orders WHERE exclude_from_sla = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND (first_responder_id IS NOT NULL OR resolver_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY COALESCE(first_responder_id, resolver_id) ORDER BY slaCompliant DESC, totalWorkOrders DESC

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS statDate, biz_tag AS bizTag, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN responded_at IS NOT NULL AND responded_at <= response_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responseCompliant, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND update_time <= sla_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolutionCompliant FROM work_orders WHERE exclude_from_sla = 0 AND biz_tag IS NOT NULL AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time), biz_tag ORDER BY statDate, bizTag

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount FROM work_orders WHERE handler_id = #{agentId} AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
